briefdescription.para: Returns the "value type" of a global value.

detaileddescription.para: This differs from the formal type of a global value which is always a pointer type.

briefdescription.para: Obtain the preferred alignment of the value.
Set the preferred alignment of the value.
Sets a metadata attachment, erasing the existing metadata attachment if it already exists for the given kind.
Erases a metadata attachment of the given kind if it exists.
Removes all metadata attachments from this value.
Retrieves an array of metadata entries representing the metadata attached to this value.

detaileddescription.para: The caller is responsible for freeing this array by calling LLVMDisposeValueMetadataEntries.

briefdescription.para: Returns the kind of a value metadata entry at a specific index.
Returns the underlying metadata node of a value metadata entry at a specific index.
This group contains functions that operate on global values.

detaileddescription.para: Functions in this group relate to functions in the llvm::GlobalValue class tree.
